answer: One concrete defense is costly, non-transferable reputation that accrues slowly, one identity at a time. Picture each honest agent climbing a ridge of attestations earned epoch by epoch; a sybil swarm would have to rebuild that whole slope from zero, not merely whisper a forged claim into the ledger. Because standing cannot be minted on demand like dashing off a quick sonnet, the economics of spinning up thousands of fake agents collapse under the compounding, unforgeable cost of real history.
